adql_template: SELECT g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.ref_epoch, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.parallax_over_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.ruwe, d.r_med_geo, d.r_lo_geo, d.r_hi_geo FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiaedr3_complements.distances AS d ON d.source_id = g.source_id WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', g.ra, g.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', {ra_deg}, {dec_deg}, {radius_deg}))

dedup_audit.angular_match_epoch: J2000.0: Gaia DR3 (epoch 2016.0) positions are propagated back with pmra / pmdec before the 3 arcsec angular fallback against the published primary coordinates

description: Gaia DR3 stars inside the 692 GBT L-band primary beams of the BL Enriquez et al. (2017) targets (cone radius FWHM/2), de-duplicated across beams and against the primaries, binned per pointing in (distance, off-axis EIRP_min).

merge_provenance.collision_rule: one record per physical star: the sighting with the minimum radial offset from its beam centre (maximum beam gain, lowest EIRP_min) is kept; ties go to the primary (on-axis) observation, then to input order

methodology_note: Reproduces the methodology of Wlodarczyk-Sroka, Garrett & Siemion (2020, MNRAS 498, 5720) - Gaia stars inside Breakthrough Listen primary beams as off-axis targets with Gaussian beam attenuation - on the 692 locked Enriquez et al. (2017) GBT L-band pointings (data/catalogs/bl_692_targets.csv) using Gaia DR3 cones of radius FWHM/2 = 4.2 arcmin, inverse-parallax distances for parallax_over_error >= 5 and Bailer-Jones et al. (2021) geometric distances for 1 < parallax_over_error < 5, d <= 10 kpc. It is NOT the published catalogue: Wlodarczyk-Sroka et al. used the 1,327 multi-band pointings of Price et al. (2020), Gaia DR2 and Bailer-Jones (2018) distances, and report 288,315 stars; counts here are not expected to match that number. Pointing centres are the published J2000 target coordinates (the telescope tracked each target's then-current position; for the fastest proper-motion primaries the centre is uncertain by up to ~0.5 arcmin of the 8.4 arcmin beam).
spatial_correlation_assumption: primary targets: exact correlated Monte Carlo over shared settlement fronts; background shells: independent product of marginal conditional-reach probabilities, prod_cells (1 - p_c q_c)^N_c, multiplied onto the primary term. Reach indicators of a Poisson-Boolean front model are positively associated (Harris-FKG), so this product is a LOWER bound on the true P(no detection | H): it can only overstate how strongly the null disfavours a hypothesis, never understate it. The Frechet upper bound min_c (1 - p_c q_c), valid under any dependence, is reported beside it; the exact value lies between the two. The sign of the effect on a Bayes factor between two hypotheses is not determined by the bound.

validation_sample.selection: numpy Generator(SeedSequence([rng_seed, 0x42474B])).choice without replacement over the de-duplicated background stars in merge order, plus every background sighting absorbed by a primary target
